summary.content:
Today's selection covers 61 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 31 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: WhatsApp Leaks User Metadata to Attackers
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: The Gentlemen ransomware now uses SystemBC for bot-powered attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 39 articles published in the last 24 hours
